message.reasoning_content: We need to read the fact: Defendant drove a loader without a professional driver's license, failed to drive safely, ran over and killed a person. So the crime is traffic accident causing death, i.e., "交通肇事罪" (dangerous driving causing death). Under Chinese criminal law, article 133 (dangerous driving) or article 132? Actually article 133 is "交通肇事罪" for causing death by violating traffic regulations. Also driving without license is illegal but the main crime is traffic accident causing death. Could also be "非法驾驶罪"? There's a specific offense "无证驾驶" is administrative, not criminal unless causing accident. So the appropriate crime: "交通肇事罪". Possibly also "过失致人死亡罪"? In Chinese law, traffic accident causing death is "交通肇事罪" (Article 133). Overly, "过失致人死亡罪" is for other contexts. So answer: [罪名]交通肇事罪<eoa>
